runtime.note: Framework-dependent single-file today, which needs a matching .NET runtime on the host. Packaged builds publish --self-contained so a node needs nothing.

commands.name: kgsm
commands.why: every domain read and write goes through the engine via kgsm-lib

commands.name: systemctl
commands.why: reports leaf liveness on the services board and restarts a leaf after a config change

commands.name: journalctl
commands.why: the host-logs page tails each leaf's journal

services.name: kgsm-monitor.service
services.without: metrics panels report unavailable; every other page works

services.name: kgsm-assistant-service.service
services.why: the chat surface relays turns to it
services.without: the chat page is unavailable; no fallback engine exists behind it, deliberately

services.name: kgsm-scheduler.service
services.why: scheduled restarts and backups on the settings page

services.name: nginx
services.why: public TLS ingress in front of the API
services.without: the API serves directly on its own port

system.why: the API restarts a leaf after a config change through a scoped polkit grant
system.note: That grant is deploy/leaf-config/49-kgsm-api-leaf-restart.rules.in — a RUNTIME grant, unlike the 48-* deploy grants, so it must be installed on a node too.

secrets.note: Never shipped in any package. Seeding it is the one genuinely manual step of node bootstrap.
